text_markup: An ability that moves cards can identify the new objects that those cards become and continue to act on them.
text_plain: An ability that moves cards can identify the new objects that those cards become and continue to act on them.

examples.text_markup: The Corp plays {card:Priority Construction}, installing a piece of ice from HQ. That ice is now a new object in the play area, but {card:Priority Construction}'s second instruction can still find it and place advancement counters on it.
examples.text_plain: The Corp plays Priority Construction, installing a piece of ice from HQ. That ice is now a new object in the play area, but Priority Construction's second instruction can still find it and place advancement counters on it.
